business_problem: integrate clinical, social, eligibility, and shelter data so care teams can quickly identify and support vulnerable New Yorkers experiencing homelessness.
solution_summary: NYC Health + Hospitals uses Snowflake, Snowpark, Secure Data Sharing, and Horizon Catalog on Snowflake to integrate clinical, social, eligibility, and shelter data so care teams can quickly identify and support vulnerable New Yorkers experiencing homelessness. Clinical, eligibility, shelter, and social-service data are centralized in Snowflake so care, outreach, and analytics teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Snowpark keeps transformation and application logic close to the governed data instead of forcing the team to move workloads into separate compute environments. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. NYC Health + Hospitals cut data refresh cycles from five days to five minutes and built a 100-billion-row data hub that supports whole-person care for people experiencing homelessness.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Runs transformations, analytics, and application logic directly where Snowflake data already lives.

solution_components.name: Secure Data Sharing
solution_components.role: Shares governed data with partners or internal consumers without moving copies.

solution_components.name: Horizon Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies cataloging, governance, and policy controls across Snowflake data assets.

data_flow: clinical, eligibility, shelter, and social-service data flow into Snowflake, Snowpark, Secure Data Sharing, and Horizon Catalog; curated data, reports, and model outputs are then served to care, outreach, and analytics teams.
business_outcome: NYC Health + Hospitals reduced critical data refresh cycles from five days to five minutes and built a more than 100-billion-row data hub that helps teams deliver whole-person care to people experiencing homelessness.
